items.name: story-export
items.title: Story Export
items.description: Turns stories into images for Instagram, WhatsApp and TikTok: renderStoryPng() draws JSX to a 1080 × 1920 PNG in the browser with Satori, shareStory() opens the share sheet with it, plus downloadStory(), loadFont() and the safe area the apps draw over.
items.docs: Next.js and webpack load Satori's layout engine by themselves. With Vite, call setStoryWasm() first with the URL of satori/layout.wasm (import wasm from "satori/layout.wasm?url").
